stories.title: Witness appeal after single-vehicle crash at Holywell Golf Course
stories.summary: North Wales Police are appealing for witnesses after a single-vehicle collision at Holywell Golf Course on Saturday evening. Officers were called to the golf course on Ffordd Calcoed in Brynford at around 8.30pm on Saturday 23 May following reports of a collision involving a silver Ford Fiesta. stories.title: Man charged with imitation firearm offences after Saltney Ferry incident
stories.summary: A 36-year-old Saltney Ferry man has been charged with four offences after North Wales Police attended a property on Saltney Terrace on Monday afternoon. stories.title: Flintshire households face £221 energy bill rise from July

stories.title: AI-Powered Banking Takes Shape in Uzbekistan as Proprietary Virtual Assistant Rolls Out Across Mobile Platform
